blocks.heading: Financial Services (Raymond James and Citi Tampa)
paragraphs: Raymond James Financial (St. Petersburg, 15 miles from Tampa — the Tampa Bay metro's dominant financial institution) and Citigroup's massive Tampa technology and operations center — one of Citigroup's largest US non-NYC employee concentrations:
Investment and wealth management AI for Raymond James's large advisor network.
Banking operations analytics and compliance AI for Citi's Tampa technology center.
Customer analytics and retention ML for Tampa Bay's financial services community (Raymond James, Regions Financial, Suncoast Credit Union).
Cost: $40,000–$115,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Healthcare (Tampa's Largest Employer Sector)
paragraphs: Tampa General Hospital, BayCare Health System (Clearwater), HCA Florida Healthcare, and WellCare Health Plans (WellCare is a major Medicaid managed care organization, Tampa HQ):
HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for Tampa General Hospital's acute care programs.
Medicaid population health analytics for WellCare's large Florida Medicaid membership.
Prior authorization and revenue cycle AI for Tampa Bay's large hospital networks.
Cost: $50,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Military and Defense (MacDill AFB and SOCOM)
paragraphs: MacDill Air Force Base (Tampa) is one of the US's most strategically important military installations — home of US Central Command (CENTCOM) and US Special Operations Command (SOCOM). The defense contractor community serving MacDill:
Commercial operations AI for defense technology companies' non-classified business (supply chain, HR, finance analytics).
Logistics analytics for the civilian logistics contractors supporting MacDill's enormous supply and maintenance operations.
Classified and ITAR-restricted work is outside ClickMasters' scope.
Cost: $25,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks

blocks.heading: Technology and SaaS
paragraphs: Tampa Bay's growing SaaS community — Syniverse Technologies (Tampa HQ, global mobile technology provider), ConnectWise (Tampa HQ, MSP management platform), and the emerging startup community:
Enterprise analytics AI for Tampa's established technology companies.
SaaS product ML for Tampa's venture-backed startup community.
Cost: $25,000–$90,000 | Timeline: 8–20 weeks

blocks.heading: Tourism and Hospitality
paragraphs: Tampa Bay's significant tourism economy — Busch Gardens, the Port of Tampa Bay (Florida's largest cruise port), and the hospitality industry serving Tampa's events and tourism market:
Cruise and tourism demand prediction for the Port of Tampa's cruise operations and related hospitality.
Hotel revenue management and dynamic pricing ML.
Cost: $30,000–$85,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks

sections.title: Tampa's AI Growth Momentum
sections.description: Tampa's technology community has accelerated significantly over the past five years.

blocks.heading: Florida's technology migration
paragraphs: Tampa Bay has been among the primary beneficiaries of the technology worker migration from California and New York — lower cost of living, no state income tax, and Florida's business climate have attracted both technology workers and company headquarters. This migration has raised Tampa's technology talent standard considerably.

blocks.heading: Tampa Bay Tech ecosystem
paragraphs: Tampa Bay Tech — the organized technology community for the Tampa Bay area — has grown its membership and programming significantly, creating networking and AI adoption support that accelerates commercial AI investment in the region.

blocks.heading: Citigroup's Tampa technology center
paragraphs: Citigroup's Tampa operations employ thousands in technology and operations roles — creating a secondary technology talent market in Tampa that has no equivalent in similarly-sized southeastern cities.

blocks.heading: University of South Florida AI programs
paragraphs: USF's growing data science and AI programs in Tampa are building a local AI talent pipeline that reduces Tampa organizations' dependence on out-of-market AI talent recruitment.
